mentions.name: Limberly
mentions.description: Limberly is a Flutter mobile app focused on health and ergonomics for sedentary workers. Still in early development, it currently provides timers for taking micro-breaks during work, for switching between sitting and standing, and for alternating the mouse hand. Planned features include a smart system that recommends specific activities during breaks, guidance for ergonomically setting up the workspace, posture coaching, and statistics tracking. The app is free to use.
mentions.problem: Sitting is detrimental to health with increased mortality rates, and the negative effects of sedentary work can be reduced through movement, resistance training, and short breaks during work, which research shows reduce fatigue and can boost performance.
mentions.audience: Sedentary workers who sit for a living.
